{{Hatnote|Date-field examples for [[Template:Card]].}}
These examples show the '''Info''' date block: '''Released''' (always when sourced), then optional '''Effective''', '''Remastered''', '''Blanked''', and '''Retired''', last before Versions. Empty rows omit. Dates are named fields; the template does not copy a set date automatically.

Sample dates and citations match the audited live version linked on each sample. A date beginning “by” is a sourced publication or slot-reuse bound, not a claim of first release.

Printed title stays the printed title. '''(Remastered)''' is a wiki qualifier, not part of the card title.
